cross-game.methodology: Combination-level structural search. For every target draw, candidate tickets are generated deterministically and ranked only from statistics strictly prior to that draw. Hyperparameters and portfolio size are selected using 2020-2022 only; 2023-2026 is research evaluation, not virgin holdout. Final promotion requires future sealed draws.

Logistic-style supervised number scoring trained only on 2015-2019. Hyperparameters and set size frozen by 2020-2022 validation before 2023-2026 research evaluation. Final promotion requires future sealed draws.

Consensus voting across pre-2023-selected v16 families. Ensemble policy is frozen solely by 2020-2022 validation rank before any 2023-2026 evaluation. 2023-2026 is research evaluation only and not a virgin final holdout. Final promotion requires sealed future draws.

For each draw, choose among v16 pre-2023-selected families using only trailing outcomes strictly before the target draw. Policy hyperparameters are compared on research period 2023-2026 and therefore are NOT a virgin holdout. Final promotion requires future sealed draws.

Each 8-number set is expanded into all 28 unique 6-number combinations. SELAE official categories 1-5 are settled exactly. Reintegro excluded because no reintegro policy was frozen; results are conservative for main categories.
Exact SELAE categories 1-5 only. Reintegro excluded because no reintegro policy was frozen for these formulas; therefore return is a conservative main-category-only measure.

Pre-holdout rank reconstructed from original v5 shard ranking. Event prizes read from persisted official SELAE economics. Euromillones main-number formulas did not freeze stars, so 4/5 events are reported as exact prize ranges by 0/1/2 stars, not as claimed realized payouts. EuroDreams 5/6 is exact because category 3 ignores Dream. Single-formula cost is shown only as an illustration; post-hoc selection is not accepted as a valid strategy.

Candidates ordered solely by pre-holdout rank from v5 shards. Test period 2023+ opened afterward. Every selected formula is charged one 0.50 EUR ticket per official SELAE draw. Reintegro excluded because v5 formulas did not freeze a reintegro policy. Categories 1-5 settled exactly; Spanish lottery special tax modeled as 20% above 40,000 EUR per winning ticket. Null full-hit probability assumes independent uniform combinations only as a reference baseline.

bonoloto.methodology: Hyperparameters ranked only on 2020-2022. Top 20 frozen before opening 2023-2024 and 2025-2026. Jackpot scoring uses actual selected tickets, not merely containment in a larger pool.

Ordered-state transition model. Each sorted winning-number position learns transitions conditioned on the same position at lag 1/2/3/5, with window, anchor bandwidth and recency weighting selected only on 2020-2022. Top30 frozen before opening 2023-2024 and 2025-latest.

Ensemble over v53 specifications already selected from 2020-2022. Committee size, rank depth and decay are ranked only on 2020-2022; top10 frozen before 2023-2024 and 2025-latest are opened. No later reranking.

Compact non-algebraic hazard family. Per-number features: short/long frequency, transition likelihood conditioned on prior draw overlap, gap, repeat/repeat2, number position/parity/low-high. 200,000 deterministic specifications sharded; cheap screen on deterministic subset of 2020-2022, global rerank on all 2020-2022, top100 frozen, then 2023-2024 and 2025-latest opened without reranking.

Graph-network family: historical pair co-occurrence links candidate numbers to anchors from the previous 1-3 draws. 50,000 deterministic graph specifications screened only on a deterministic 2020-2022 subset; global top candidates fully reranked on all 2020-2022; top 100 frozen before opening 2023-2024 and 2025-latest. No later reranking.

Optimized successor to cancelled v22. State vectors are cached by window; each target/config transition model is computed once and shared by all portfolio sizes. Hyperparameters and portfolio size rank only on 2020-2022. Top 20 are frozen, then 2023-2024 and 2025-2026 are opened without reranking. Later windows are research evaluation, not virgin holdout for the wider project.

1,000,000 deterministic Budget8 models sharded. Cheap screening uses only a deterministic sample of 2020-2022. Global candidates are fully reranked only on all 2020-2022, top 100 frozen, then 2023-2024 and 2025-latest opened without reranking.

Use only v15 candidate specs with setSize exactly 8. Rank exclusively on 2020-2022. Freeze top 50, then open 2023-2024 and 2025-latest without reranking. A full capture means all six winning numbers are inside the 8-number pool, equivalent to a guaranteed 6/6 among its 28 combinations.

Focused retrospective ridge search around the three independently observed v26-family full-hit parameter region. Exactly 2,000,000 deterministic mode-2/mirror-false specs are scored only on the known full dates 2023-03-19, 2023-07-31 and 2024-05-22. Top 1000 are frozen by that discovery rank before 2025-latest is evaluated. 2025+ is a later-era research evaluation, not virgin holdout for the wider project.

Enumerate all C(49,6)=13,983,816 fixed tickets. Ticket scores use only 2010-2018 normalized number/pair/triple frequencies. Hyperparameter and portfolio size chosen only on 2019-2022. Same frozen tickets then repeated unchanged on every 2023-latest draw. 2023+ is research evaluation, not virgin holdout for the wider project.

1,000,000 deterministic broad formula IDs sharded. Candidate screening and top-1000 selection use only 2020-2022. 2023-2024 and 2025-latest are then opened without reranking. These later years are research evaluation, not virgin holdout, because the project has previously studied them.
